parsed.faithful: Act of Faith, Auto da Fe, in the Romish church is a solemn day held by the inquisition, for the punishment of heretics, and the abolition of the innocent accused. They usually contrive the Auto to fall on some great festival, that the execution may pass with the more awe and regard; at least it is always on a Sunday.
